admissionNote: The owner accepted these exact per-provider limits and default-build equivalence on 2026-11-11. Each provider retains its recorded CPU, API DLL, harness and checkpoint identity, with the exact protected application tree and build-input snapshots required by the verifier.
derivation: Use the median of three steady repetitions as the reference and the observed worst repetition as the proposed ceiling or throughput floor. Relative tolerance reflects observed spread. Evaluate each provider on equivalent CPU and runtime, or explicitly rebaseline. Error and HTTP 429 ceilings are zero.

equivalentSnapshots.rationale: The exact additional Directory.Build.targets sets NuGetLockFilePath only when KafdeckNativeRid is nonempty. All 95 exact native RID lock files are referenced only in that conditional mode. With KafdeckNativeRid unset, the default build retains the measured props/packages/global/NuGet configuration. This equivalence applies only to the recorded path/mode/blob snapshot; any edit, added or deleted selected input requires another review.

soakDerivation.method: Use eight consecutive windows anchored at the first soak operation launch. Retain overflow in the last window and divide its operation count by the remaining measured phase duration. Each upper bound is the worst window statistic and each throughput floor is the minimum window rate. Relative allowance is observed spread from the median of the eight window statistics. Keep every raw operation and sample.
soakDerivation.precision: JSON retains binary64 round-trip precision. Verifier comparisons allow four ULPs for final binary rounding only.
soakDerivation.growth: Existing growth and idle limits are unchanged. Preserve signed net/segment growth measurements. The existing increase-only growth ceiling is max(0, worst segment growth); zero ceilings remain zero.

admissionProposal.decision: Approve each provider's complete proposed numeric limits as its own baseline on the recorded exact CPU model, runtime, resource profile and topology. Preserve that provider's API DLL, harness and checkpoint hashes and require the current protected application tree to equal the measured source tree. A different CPU, binary, runtime, topology or source tree requires a separately reviewed baseline or artifact binding decision. Cross-provider numbers do not establish hardware or binary equivalence.
admissionProposal.quality: Zero logical-operation errors and zero HTTP 429 responses throughout all mandatory phases. Require all phases, raw operation validation, telemetry coverage, cancellation recovery, physical PostgreSQL replay and cleanup evidence.
admissionProposal.variation: One completed two-hour soak per provider supplies eight within-run windows. These windows describe observed time variation within that run, with no additional cross-run allowance.
admissionProposal.buildInputs: Approve the exact baseline and proposed equivalent default-build snapshots listed in buildInputIdentity, with KafdeckNativeRid unset. Retain every original provider binary and checkpoint identity. A future candidate source change or binary change requires explicitly reviewed new evidence; this decision reuses the current retained acceptance runs only.
